notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Lurrus of the Dream-Den this turn.
description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Lurrus.
When the artifact enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact cast in step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.
